 Louisville voter? Find the early voting location closest to you
 Louisville Public Media | 
 By
 Justin Hicks 
 Published October 28, 2026 at 3:02 PM EDT
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Justin Hicks 
 / 
 KPR A tablet sits ready for voters at Louisville's first drive-through voting center, opening during the 2026 General Election, located at the Kentucky Expo Center. 
 Louisville Public Media’s latest tool uses real-time driving directions to find your quickest route to an early voting location. Early voting is open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Thursday through Saturday.
 Louisville voters can use the tool below to enter their address and see the nearest early voting locations and the fastest route to get there. Early voting locations aren’t precinct-specific, meaning that unlike Election Day, any Jefferson County resident can choose where they want to vote.
 Also, for the first time, Louisville election officials have added a drive-thru voting site at the Kentucky Expo Center.
 “So sometimes it’s hard to get the kids out and show an ID and go in and vote, or if you’re someone who has mobility issues, you might not be able to walk into a place,” said Ashley Tinius with the Jefferson County Clerk’s Office.
 Drive-thru voters are asked to enter the fairgrounds at Gate 4 and take a right past the toll booths in order to enter the South Wing building at the E19 loading dock. If the drive-thru lines are long, the clerk’s office wants voters to be considerate for less mobile voters and walk in to vote.
 Before you go, read and make your voting decisions on LPM’s voter guide to zip through the polls.
 Early voting locations are open October 29, 30 and 31 from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
